items.context: Can you confirm if you received the order?
items.text: theek hai

items.context: Is the item damaged or wrong?
items.text: haan ji

items.context: Have you received your replacement yet?
items.text: abhi tak nahi
mera jo item aaya woh bilkul galat hai
umm matlab jo cream maine order ki thi woh lotion aa gaya hai
accha toh mera parcel to damage ho gaya hai dekh ke
wednesday ko maine order diya tha delivery kab hogi
haan ji woh mujhe chahiye tha lekin size wrong mila
mein refund lena chahta hu kyunki item damaged hai
meri order id pe ek aur item aa gaya hai galat wala

items.context: What seems to be the issue with your delivery?
items.text: item size galat hai mujhe bada chahiye tha

items.context: Can you tell me what is wrong with the product?
items.text: damage product mila mujhe replacement chahiye

items.context: Please specify the item you received incorrectly.
items.text: maine violet lipstick order ki thi lekin red lipstick mili hai

items.context: Was there a delay in delivery or a product issue?
items.text: delivery thodi der se aayi thi par product toh sahi tha

items.context: Was the order delivered to the correct address?
items.text: wednesday ko ship kara tha wo galat address pe pahunch gaya
meri order ki hui shoes ka ek pair damaged tha jab main unhe open kiya tha
maine 15 april ko order diya tha lekin mera jo packet aaya usme lipstick ki jagah ek cream thi
mainne do books order ki thi aur jis book ko cancel karna tha maine galti se doosri cancel kar diya

items.context: How has receiving the wrong item affected you?
items.text: item galat aane ki wajah se mujhe kaafi problem hui main chahta hu ki aap jaldi se replacement bhejein

items.context: Could you tell me about the product quality and your refund request?
items.text: product ki quality bhi bahut kharab thi aur mujhe refund chahiye tha par abhi tak confirmation nahi aaya hai

items.context: Are you considering cancelling your order due to previous issues?
items.text: order cancel karne ki soch raha hu kyunki pichli baar galat item mila tha aur delivery delay bhi hui thi

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: wrong_or_damaged - received a wrong or damaged item
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
